scatters.name: SCATTER
scatters.behavior:
PROGRESSIVE MULTIPLIER FREE SPINS
 At the beginning of the PROGRESSIVE MULTIPLIER FREE SPINS ROUND, the player is
 awarded one of the following starting multipliers:
 7 awards a starting multiplier of 3x
 6 awards a starting multiplier of 2x
 5 awards a starting multiplier of 1x
 The round starts with 15 Free Spins.
After every free spin, the win multiplier increases by 1x, 2x or 3x, depending on the number of Scatter symbols
 that triggered the round, up to a maximum of 30x win multiplier.
 If the total win of a PROGRESSIVE MULTIPLIER FREE SPINS ROUND is less than 10x the bet that
 triggered the round, the player is automatically awarded a 10x bet multiplier.
 The win of each free spin is multiplied by the current multiplier.
 5 SCATTER symbols on any reel during the PROGRESSIVE MULTIPLIER FREE SPINS ROUND
 award 15 additional free spins, up to a total of 60 free spins.
 Feature can be retriggered.
 Special reels are in play during FREE SPINS feature.
